Package parking.domain.model

Class ParkingSpace

java.lang.Object
parking.domain.model.ParkingSpace
public class ParkingSpace extends Object
A physical space in the parking lot.

A space is responsible for its own SpaceStatus and for deciding whether it is compatible with a given Vehicle (isCompatibleWith(Vehicle)). No class outside this one is allowed to mutate its status directly: every transition goes through occupy(), release() or markOutOfService(), each of which enforces its own preconditions.
